13. Mr Shameem Haider Patwary, the learned Advocate for the petitioner submits that in section 103 of the Bank Companies Act, 1991 it is stated that where an individual has, or several persons have jointly deposited money with a bank company in his or in their name, that individual depositor may separately or, as the case may be, the group of depositors may jointly, in the way prescribed, choose a person to which, in the case of the death of the individual depositor or of all of the joint depositors, the deposited money shall be given to that person. It further states that the person nominated shall after the death of the individual depositor or as the case may be, of all of the joint depositors, attain all the rights the individual depositor or the joint depositors had on that deposit, and every other person shall be deprived of those rights. 

 28. Section 103 of the Bank Companies Act, reads as follows: 

 29. On perusal of the above law it appears that the clause-3 of section 103 state at the person nominated shall after the death of the individual depositor or as the case may be, of all of the joint depositors, attain all the rights the individual depositor or the joint depositors had on that deposit, and every other person shall be deprived of those rights. 

 40. From the above position of the case, it appears that the case was filed under section 372 of the Succession Act, 1925, according to Hindu Succession Act it was decided. But in the present case it appears that the succession cases are pending between the parties and not yet disposed and this writ petition has been filed against the inaction of the respondent No.5 bank to disburse the pension benefit according to nomination of the deceased bank official. The Bank Companies Act, 1991 specifically according to section 103 of the Bank Companies Ain, 1991 and পেনশন সহজীকরণ নীতিমালা, ২০০৯ the petitioner is entitled to receive the amount. This position is also supported in the above mention cases referred to by the learned Advocate for the respondent.
